# HAPI v0.27.3.4

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Carries the deferred ready+clean batch from the v0.27.3.3 hotfix cycle plus newer upstream fixes: #1541 (Cursor permission-abort honored before ACP retry), #1543 (wrapped inline code backgrounds preserved in shared images), #1546 (Simplified Chinese labels for Fork/Rewind + confirmation dialogs), #1547 (stabilized autocomplete dropdown layout), #1548 (AGENT_NOTIFY_SUMMARY localized by namespace UI locale with retry-safe locale writes), #1552 (sidebar and file-preview scroll preserved across navigation/remounts), #1557 (Codex native instructions preserved; new goal statuses filtered), #1560 (latest session tail prioritized on re-entry), #1563 (Pi autonomous agent lifecycles settle instead of being swallowed), #1565 (clarified displayed media labels), #1568 (display_image user-output semantics clarified), #1569 (Codex sync label shortened; action menu sized to content and centered on trigger).
- Adds the fork Pi slash-command support: `/compact`, `/session`, `/model`, `/help` typed in web chat now route through the prompt FIFO as real Pi commands instead of falling through to the LLM (fork PR #6); keeps `/compact` interruptible and honors extension precedence at token boundaries.
- Records the v0.27.3.3 carry backlog that was already in-tree (SSE mobile recovery, Rewind crash guard, session pinning, steer superset, session import, and friends) as `carry` in the release ledger with unchanged heads.
- Per the 2026-08-13 operator ruling, PR #1091 (managed agent API profiles) stays `drop` until its session model-picker grouping is fixed; new agent-provider PRs #1566 (DeepSeek Harness) and #1567 (Reasonix) are deferred, and #1564 (display-links MCP) is deferred on a HAPI Bot Major finding.

## Compared with the official release

- Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.3.3`, based on official HAPI `v0.27.3` (upstream `main` unchanged since `febbf8ff5`), plus the 12 new carried upstream fixes and the fork Pi slash-command support above.
- Uses four-part version `0.27.3.4`; platform optional dependencies remain pinned to official `0.27.3`.
